title: heat_tier
description: The `heat_tier` content kind (megaplan 1.7 and task 8-T1): one tier of the server-wide Heat meter (0 to 100). One tier per file, `tier` 1 to 5 (every number once; a datapack file with the same id replaces a default). The meter enters the tier when it rises to `enter` or above and leaves it when it falls below `exit` (`exit` is below `enter`, so the tier does not flicker). While the meter is in the tier it decays by `decay_per_s` points a second, after `grace_s` seconds without new chaos. `host_wanted` is the real wanted level (0 to 5) a host's game is given while the tier applies to it (the `heat` message, Phase 0 (e)); `top_chaos_wanted`, when present, replaces it for the one player who caused the most chaos (tier 4: Max-Tac hunts them). Without the Phase 0 (e) write, hosts get the Minecraft `response` like everyone else. `response` is what hunts the players of the tier in the replica: `target` says who (area: patrols near every player, loudest: the players who caused the most chaos, top_chaos: only the top one, everyone), `waves` the `spawn_palette` entries sent (one entry every `every_s` seconds, at most `max_alive` of the tier's figures at once). Night City entries go through the host's game for hosts when it allows, else they are the entry's Minecraft squad. Names and text are original.
